member.name: M:WebProj.TransSalesReturnLedger.SaveSalesPaymentsRefund(System.String)
member.summary:
Added by janine May 20 2015
This function is an addition to the sales return function, particularly, REFUND. This is to insert a negative or contra value to the payment made. Example: if the client returned all of the items in an invoice (it should work like void), a negative value of the amount paid will be inserted so that in the dashboard sales reports, it will be easy to sum and still get the correct amount in the inventory of payments. so if the cashamount is 100 originally, and the client wants a refund, another -100 will be inserted.
For invoices wherein only part of the items are refunded, there is a formula applied. the payment method average will be used as contra value of the amount (in case of multiple payment type made)
Also note that for payment methods such as Other Type and Credit Card, there is a specific contra value inserted to to their respective tables. This is because Other Type payment methods can be SMAC, EPlus, or voucher and the credit card could be visa, mastercard, etc. For easier summation purposes in the dashboard reports, the inserted contra values for refund are necessary.
